_about: The reviewed decisions for the sages' portraits: the cover of each sage's own podcast episode, cut to his head and shoulders. "portraits" holds the kept ones (crop = [x, y, size] in the pixels of the 640 x 640 cover, image = the cover's hash, kind = illustration, or photo only for an id in _approved_photos); "_left_out" holds every other sage with the reason and a note, and for a photograph or an uncertain one the crop and image that were recorded anyway, so approving more photographs later is adding their ids to _approved_photos (scripts/build_portraits.py then builds them) with no second review. Merged from the five reviewers' files; scripts/build_portraits.py builds public/portraits/*, assets/og/portraits/* and public/data-portraits.json from it.
